_comment: Committed expected-GA capability-manifest snapshot for honua-release#61's live capability-manifest canonical check (e2e/canonical_checks.py:check_capability_manifest). `expectedGa` (minus `excluded`) is the id set every deployed candidate must advertise as supported=true; when the check runs authenticated (an admin X-API-Key) it also asserts available=true for the same set. REFRESH RULE: this file is asserted against a LIVE deployment, so it must only be refreshed from a deployment that is actually running the manifest-pinned candidate — refreshing it from a stale environment would red a live canary to green a candidate, or vice versa. This snapshot was taken from demo.honua.io while it served deploymentRevision 6b6d3b898f4abb6b34833d953b50d44f3d38c6c1, the sha pinned in platform-manifest.yaml, immediately after that redeploy. Versus the previous 2026-07-21 snapshot it removes ai.workflow-generation (retired by honua-server ADR-0076 / #3255 / #3264) and adds sync.offline and temporal.animation-api.

excluded.reason: No longer advertised as a capability id at all on this candidate (it survives as the `mtls` TRANSPORT, reported available=false / disabled-by-configuration). Previously it was advertised supported=true but gated; honua-server#2958 tracks the reclassification. Kept here so the exclusion's history is legible if the id returns.

Gated: disabled-by-configuration (geofence enter/exit alerting is not enabled on every deployment profile). Present in the manifest as supported=true but not asserted available on a bare/demo deployment.
